resources.string: Automatic organizing is not active. Build 3.1 engineering: file changes are disabled by safety gates. Downloads inventory remains read-only.
Engineering build · Persistent history and recovery foundation

All Files Access is intended for organizing downloaded files in later builds. Inventory reads only filenames, types, sizes and dates from Downloads. Recovery may read and hash journaled files locally within strict limits. It does not classify content, scan inside folders, or move, copy, rename or delete files.
Tap Open Settings and allow access for S26 Download Organizer. If a list of apps opens, choose this app. Return here when finished; access will be checked again.
Storage settings could not be opened. Open your phone’s Settings, find Special app access → All files access, and choose S26 Download Organizer. Return here to check access again.
This build’s read-only inventory requires Android 11 or newer. On Android 8–10, the dashboard is available but Downloads access is not supported. No legacy storage permission is requested.
